Title: The 5th School Teachers' First Responder Course
NewsSummary: The School Teachers' First Responder Course gathered 30 passionate learners from various educational organisations who successfully completed the training, emerging as skilled and confident first responders.
NewsContent:
The 5th School Teachers' First Responder Course was recently held at CIME. This course gathered 30 passionate learners from various educational organisations who successfully completed the training, emerging as skilled and confident first responders.

This intensive training initiative was designed to empower educators with the essential life-saving skills necessary to respond swiftly and effectively in times of crisis. Participants immersed themselves in a curriculum that not only bolstered their confidence but also enhanced their capability to ensure the safety and well-being of their students and school communities.

We extend our heartfelt congratulations to all the participants for their commitment and enthusiasm throughout the programme. Their dedication to becoming first responders is a testament to their profound sense of responsibility and the collective vision of building a safer and more prepared community.

As we celebrate the accomplishments of these passionate educators, we recognize that their newfound skills will undoubtedly make a significant difference when it matters most. This training not only equips them with the tools to save lives but also reinforces the invaluable role educators play in shaping a more resilient and secure future for our communities.
